name: Notepad
note: A 'desktop' app shows running when a process named 'processName' (its .exe, without extension) is found, and Stop ends that process.

name: Example Web Server
note: Serves the bundled dashboards over HTTP with Python's built-in server (needs Python installed). 'web' apps show running when their port answers, and the browser opens when it goes live. 'env' sets variables for the process; PYTHONUNBUFFERED makes its log lines stream into the terminal immediately.

name: Sample CSV Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for CSV/TSV. Auto-profiles any file and renders it; ships differently-shaped sample tabs. Runs offline, no server. {MP_HOME} resolves to Moonpool's folder, so the tile also works from a portable bundle.

name: Sample JSON Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for JSON (arrays, nested objects, or maps; nested keys flattened automatically).

name: Sample Excel Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for Excel .xlsx / .xls workbooks, parsed offline with a vendored SheetJS.

name: PowerShell Session
note: A 'cli' app opens an interactive shell in 'cwd'. This one prints the date first, then stays open. Use the unquoted '-NoExit -Command <tokens>' form; leave off '-Command ...' for a plain shell.

name: Moonpool Docs
note: Offline Markdown docs browser hosting Moonpool's own help.
